rules.name: IAM CreatePolicyVersion
rules.description: User can create a new version of an existing policy containing unrestricted administrative access and set it as the default version.
rules.mitigation: Restrict iam:CreatePolicyVersion or enforce permissions boundaries that prevent modifying managed policies.

rules.name: IAM SetDefaultPolicyVersion
rules.description: User can switch the default policy version to a previous, potentially more permissive policy version.
rules.mitigation: Restrict iam:SetDefaultPolicyVersion or prune obsolete permissive policy versions.

rules.name: IAM CreateAccessKey
rules.description: User can generate access keys for any IAM user, allowing impersonation of administrators.
rules.mitigation: Restrict iam:CreateAccessKey to specific user ARN or enforce self-service only via aws:username condition.

rules.name: IAM CreateLoginProfile / UpdateLoginProfile
rules.description: User can create or reset console passwords for any IAM user.
rules.mitigation: Do not grant unrestricted iam:CreateLoginProfile or iam:UpdateLoginProfile permissions.

rules.name: IAM AttachPolicy (User / Group / Role)
rules.description: User can attach managed policies (such as AdministratorAccess) to themselves, groups, or assumable roles.
rules.mitigation: Restrict iam:Attach*Policy permissions using IAM condition keys or permissions boundaries.

rules.name: IAM PutPolicy (User / Group / Role)
rules.description: User can inject arbitrary inline policies granting full administrative privileges.
rules.mitigation: Disallow iam:Put*Policy permissions and enforce managed policies governed by IaC.

rules.name: IAM AddUserToGroup
rules.description: User can add themselves or other entities to privileged administrative groups.
rules.mitigation: Restrict iam:AddUserToGroup to non-admin groups or require approval workflows.

rules.name: IAM UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
rules.description: User can alter trust relationships of administrative roles to grant themselves assumption rights.
rules.mitigation: Protect role trust policies and enforce approval controls on iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy.

rules.name: EC2 RunInstances + PassRole
rules.description: User can launch an EC2 instance with an attached high-privilege instance profile and extract temporary credentials via IMDS.
rules.mitigation: Restrict iam:PassRole with Resource constraints specifying only low-privilege service roles.

rules.name: Lambda CreateFunction + PassRole + Invoke
rules.description: User can create and invoke a Lambda function executing under an administrative IAM role.
rules.mitigation: Scope iam:PassRole to specific Lambda roles and enforce code review pipelines.

rules.name: Glue CreateDevEndpoint + PassRole
rules.description: User can create an AWS Glue development endpoint attached to a privileged role to execute arbitrary code.
rules.mitigation: Restrict iam:PassRole on AWS Glue service endpoints.

rules.name: CloudFormation CreateStack + PassRole
rules.description: User can deploy a CloudFormation stack using an administrative service role to create new admin assets.
rules.mitigation: Constrain CloudFormation role passing and enforce stack change-set approvals.

rules.name: CodeBuild CreateProject + StartBuild + PassRole
rules.description: User can create a CodeBuild project with a high-privilege service role and run build steps with arbitrary commands.
rules.mitigation: Limit CodeBuild service role permissions and restrict iam:PassRole targets.

rules.name: SageMaker CreateNotebookInstance + PassRole
rules.description: User can launch a SageMaker notebook instance using an admin role and access terminal shell.
rules.mitigation: Restrict SageMaker instance profile assignments and enforce VPC-only connectivity.
